mapper.select: SELECT PERMISSION_ID AS "permissionId" , NAME AS "name" , REMARK AS "description" , STATUS AS "status" , PROCESS_TIMESTAMP AS "createdAt" FROM PERMISSIONS WHERE ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR PERMISSION_ID ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' ) ORDER BY PROCESS_TIMESTAMP DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total" FROM PERMISSIONS WHERE ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR PERMISSION_ID ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' )

SELECT MENU_ID AS "menuId", MENU_NAME AS "menuName", COUNT(*) AS "permissionCount" FROM PERMISSIONS WHERE STATUS = '01' AND MENU_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MENU_ID, MENU_NAME ORDER BY MENU_ID ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MENU_ID) AS "total" FROM PERMISSIONS WHERE STATUS = '01' AND MENU_ID IS NOT NULL

SELECT PERMISSION_ID AS "permissionId" , NAME AS "name" , REMARK AS "description" , STATUS AS "status" , MENU_ID AS "menuId" , MENU_NAME AS "menuName" , OWNER_ROLE_ID AS "roleId" , SYSTEM AS "system" , FIRST_REGISTER_BRANCH AS "firstRegisterBranch" , FIRST_REGISTER_USER AS "firstRegisterUser" , FIRST_REGISTER_DATE AS "firstRegisterDate" , FIRST_REGISTER_TIME AS "firstRegisterTime" , LAST_CHANGE_BRANCH AS "lastChangeBranch" , LAST_CHANGE_USER AS "lastChangeUser" , LAST_CHANGE_DATE AS "lastChangeDate" , LAST_CHANGE_TIME AS "lastChangeTime" , PROCESS_TIMESTAMP AS "createdAt" FROM PERMISSIONS WHERE PERMISSION_ID = #{permissionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PERMISSIONS ( PERMISSION_ID, PROCESS_TIMESTAMP, STATUS, NAME, REMARK, OWNER_ROLE_ID, SYSTEM, MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, FIRST_REGISTER_BRANCH, FIRST_REGISTER_USER, FIRST_REGISTER_DATE, FIRST_REGISTER_TIME, LAST_CHANGE_BRANCH, LAST_CHANGE_USER, LAST_CHANGE_DATE, LAST_CHANGE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{permissionId}, COALESCE(#{processTimestamp}, now()), COALESCE(#{status}, '01'), #{name}, #{description}, #{roleId}, #{system}, #{menuId}, #{menuName}, #{firstRegisterBranch}, #{firstRegisterUser}, #{firstRegisterDate}, #{firstRegisterTime}, #{lastChangeBranch}, #{lastChangeUser}, #{lastChangeDate}, #{lastChangeTime} )
